abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Brostamide reduces side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor increases side effects compared with Standard care.
conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Brostamide reduces side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor increases side effects compared with Standard care.
section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Willow Lane Cohort.

Table 2. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Side effects | 221 | 750 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Side effects | 161 | 750 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Side effects | 297 | 750 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
